verdict.rationale: Teller documents a REST API that an agent could call to retrieve live balances, ledger transactions (with pagination) and identity for accounts the end-user authorized, authenticated with Teller-issued mTLS client certificates. However, linking is done through the Teller Connect widget rather than a documented programmatic link-session endpoint, and probes found no MCP surface, llms.txt or OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: programmatic link-session creation, documented connection/enrollment management endpoints, an MCP server, scoped or least-privilege credential controls, machine-readable API specs, and independent agent-use corroboration.
